annotation_protocol.review: single manual visual review of 4-second samples and all emitted PPE-event frames
rules: Annotate only visible motion and PPE that can be seen; use unknown when equipment or body is occluded.
Do not treat detector predictions as ground truth.
This is a short qualitative review, not a dense frame-by-frame annotation set.

source.title: Building construction Moira Close Broadwater Farm Haringey 2025 16.webm
source.author: Acabashi

derived_clip.transcode_command: ffmpeg -ss 236 -t 34 -i commons-source.webm -vf scale=1280:-2,fps=15 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an construction-clip.mp4
derived_clip.distribution: Not committed; local test asset only.

performance_segment.transcode_command: ffmpeg -i construction-clip.mp4 -ss 18 -t 8 -vf fps=15 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an perf-segment-18-26.mp4

manual_observations.subject: construction workers in frame
manual_observations.observation: Real camera motion is not required for the clip to be dynamic: workers move across the lower work area and upper platform, bend and carry boards/materials. All 510 decoded frames have distinct hashes.

manual_observations.subject: visibly equipped workers at sampled points 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32 s
manual_observations.observation: Visible heads show hard hats and visible torsos show high-visibility clothing at the sampled timestamps. Parts of workers are intermittently hidden by the concrete wall, platform edge, stacked material or carried boards.
manual_observations.ppe_label: helmet and high-visibility vest visibly present at sampled points; no continuous interval annotation

manual_observations.subject: Person track 1 candidate, lower work area
manual_observations.observation: The visible person box center moves from just outside the configured ROI right boundary on the first frame to inside by the ROI-enter record at 4.667 s.
manual_observations.event_label: coarse ROI entry interval; sparse-frame boundary time

manual_observations.subject: Person track 113 candidate, lower work area
manual_observations.observation: A person is visible near the left edge and enters the configured ROI no later than the 15.467 s processed frame.
manual_observations.event_label: coarse ROI entry; exact onset partly occluded

manual_observations.subject: Person track 113 candidate, lower work area
manual_observations.observation: The worker carrying material moves right; the tracked box center is outside the ROI by 19.467 s and the 20 s sampled frame shows the worker farther right.

manual_observations.subject: workers carrying boards/materials
manual_observations.observation: Bodies and PPE are intermittently occluded by stacked boards and the concrete wall; fully visible equipment status is not assigned during those occlusions.

manual_observations.subject: forklift/person conflict
manual_observations.observation: No forklift is visible in this clip.
